question: How do the deposited IFNG, GZMB and IL18RAP response estimates differ between R5A11D and WTD at each reported dose and source block?
decision: Describe transport of the specified output pattern, retain disagreements and decide which matched protein comparison remains justified.
strongest_rival: Source-specific normalization/fitting, ligand identity, activation schedule, dose or unresolved donor-code identity can explain differences without a shared biological mechanism.
discriminator: Show every source estimate, both doses, all single-code omissions and positive-pair-ratio sensitivity; no cross-study causal decomposition.
exposure_record: Published Saxton/Gorby findings, Saxton outputs, all source metadata and v1/v2 qualifications are exposed. One first-row GZMB estimate was seen during schema inspection. The three genes were fixed before that exposure. No cross-ligand target differences have been inspected or calculated before this numerical freeze.
biological_unit: Three author-reported human donor codes D85/D93/D36; independent donor crosswalk unresolved. Each code supplies within-source ligand comparisons.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated comparisons from the same source code are dependent. Omissions reuse sources. Cross-study sample overlap is unknown; published/model reanalyses of these data are not replication.
population_and_selection: All 36 records for three targets fixed before cross-ligand contrasts in twelve unselected deposited CD8 comparison tables; doses 0.1 and 50 nM, dimeric WT and R5A11D only.
contrast: Within source code and dose: reported log2foldchange(R5A11D versus control) minus reported log2foldchange(WTD versus control). Secondary positive-pair-ratio difference, not a common-matrix effect.
endpoint: Deposited transcript-response estimates and source-derived ratios; not protein, secretion, cytotoxicity or IL-18 competence.
methods: METHODS_V1.md: retain every code, arithmetic mean and all single-code omissions. No pseudocount, fitting, p-values, population intervals or cross-study pooling. Independently verify raw-input arithmetic and inspect figure.
missingness_and_exclusions: No target replacements or outcome exclusions. Secondary log2 ratio only for finite strictly positive paired values; missing required code holds the entire corresponding summary. Values below 1 flagged without exclusion.
multiplicity: Fixed three targets and two doses; descriptive primary and named sensitivity quantities. No significance tests, gene screen or FDR claims.
precision_basis: Finite source description with unknown independent donor crosswalk; no population precision or confirmatory sample-size claim. Omission ranges are sensitivity, not confidence intervals.
interpretation_limit: Differences between deposited estimates cannot be interpreted as a raw-count or common-expression-matrix treatment effect. RNA does not establish signaling or function. No independent biological validation, novelty or accepted RQ claim.
stop_rule: Stop on schema/hash/target identity mismatch or arithmetic verification failure. Preserve all outputs and source inconsistencies; do not rescue failed common-matrix qualification.
amendment_reason: Initial numerical description after v2 table qualification; the v1 common-matrix failure is preserved and its proposed numerical method is superseded by SOURCE_AMENDMENT_V2.md.
